feature: Add ESLint and Prettier configuration for code consistency
description: Configure ESLint and Prettier for an Expo React Native TypeScript project to enforce code style, catch common errors (unused variables, missing dependencies in hooks, accessibility issues), and improve code quality through automated linting.

subtasks.description: Install ESLint and TypeScript ESLint parser/plugin as dev dependencies

phases.description: Create ESLint and Prettier configuration files with appropriate rules for the project

subtasks.completion_notes: Created comprehensive .eslintrc.js configuration (commit 8b18af65) with all required features: extends TypeScript/React/React Hooks/React Native recommended configs, Prettier integration as final extension to avoid conflicts, @typescript-eslint/parser configured, React Native environment settings, import ordering rules, special overrides for test and config files, and comprehensive ignore patterns. All acceptance criteria verified and working correctly.

subtasks.completion_notes: .eslintignore file created at root (commit d610ca00) with comprehensive exclusions for node_modules, build directories (android/, ios/, build/, dist/, web-build/), generated files (.expo/, .auto-claude/, .automaker/), backup/patch files (*.orig, *.rej, *.patch), config files, IDE directories, and logs. All acceptance criteria met.

subtasks.title: Create Prettier configuration file
subtasks.description: Create .prettierrc with consistent code formatting rules suitable for React Native/TypeScript
acceptance_criteria: Sensible defaults for React Native project
Tab width and semicolon preferences set
subtasks.completion_notes: Created comprehensive .prettierrc configuration (commit 1c40b258) with single quotes for JS/TS, double quotes for JSX, semicolons enabled, ES5 trailing commas, 100 character print width, 2 space indentation, LF line endings, arrow parentheses always included, and bracket spacing enabled. Configuration optimized for React Native/TypeScript/Expo projects. All acceptance criteria met.

subtasks.title: Create Prettier ignore file
subtasks.description: Create .prettierignore to exclude files that should not be formatted
subtasks.completion_notes: Created comprehensive .prettierignore file (commit 381df383) with exclusions for node_modules, build directories, lock files (package-lock.json, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml), generated files, native platform directories (android/, ios/), backup/patch files, config files, IDE directories, and temporary files. Mirrors .eslintignore exclusions. All acceptance criteria met.

phases.title: Add NPM Scripts
phases.description: Add convenient npm scripts for running linting and formatting commands

subtasks.title: Add lint and format scripts to package.json
subtasks.description: Add npm scripts for lint, lint:fix, format, and format:check commands
acceptance_criteria: npm run lint command runs ESLint on src/ and root TypeScript files
npm run lint:fix command auto-fixes ESLint issues
npm run format command formats code with Prettier
npm run format:check command checks formatting without modifying files
subtasks.completion_notes: Successfully added npm scripts to package.json (commit ac617f26). Scripts include: lint (runs ESLint on all .ts,.tsx,.js,.jsx files), lint:fix (auto-fixes ESLint issues), format (formats code with Prettier), and format:check (validates formatting). All scripts tested and working correctly with ESLint v8.57.1 and Prettier. All acceptance criteria met.

phases.title: VS Code Integration
phases.description: Configure VS Code for automatic linting and formatting on save

subtasks.title: Update VS Code settings for auto-fix on save
subtasks.description: Configure .vscode/settings.json to run ESLint fix and Prettier format on file save
acceptance_criteria: editor.defaultFormatter set to Prettier for JS/TS/TSX files
subtasks.completion_notes: Created .vscode/settings.json (commit 6824a6dd) with comprehensive VS Code configuration for ESLint and Prettier integration. All acceptance criteria met: editor.formatOnSave enabled, Prettier set as default formatter for JS/TS/TSX/JSON files, ESLint auto-fix on save configured via editor.codeActionsOnSave, ESLint validation enabled for all JavaScript/TypeScript file types. Also included helpful editor settings: LF line endings, final newline insertion, and trailing whitespace trimming.

subtasks.title: Create VS Code extensions recommendations
subtasks.description: Create .vscode/extensions.json to recommend ESLint and Prettier extensions to team members
subtasks.completion_notes: Created .vscode/extensions.json (commit dc1a2b21) recommending ESLint extension (dbaeumer.vscode-eslint) and Prettier extension (esbenp.prettier-vscode). Team members will be prompted to install these extensions automatically. All acceptance criteria met.
